mapper.sql: SELECT b.cost_dimension_key dimensionKey,b.warehouse_id warehouseId,b.sku_id skuId, b.last_cost_ledger_sequence balanceSequence,COALESCE(MAX(l.cost_ledger_sequence),0) ledgerSequence, b.record_version recordVersion,b.updated_at observedAt FROM inv_cost_balance b LEFT JOIN inv_cost_ledger l ON l.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND l.cost_dimension_key=b.cost_dimension_key
mapper.select: WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND b.store_id=#{storeId} AND b.cost_dimension_key=#{dimensionKey} GROUP BY b.cost_dimension_key,b.warehouse_id,b.sku_id,b.last_cost_ledger_sequence,b.record_version,b.updated_at
